title: CI/CD in 60 seconds
caption: CI/CD in 60 seconds: every push gets tested and shipped by a machine, the same way every time.

scenes.say: Shipping by hand means a long checklist, and hoping nobody skips a step.
CI/CD hands that to a machine, in two halves.

items.title: Continuous integration
items.text: every push is built and tested
items.say: Continuous integration: every push is built and tested automatically.

items.title: Continuous delivery
items.say: Continuous delivery: every build that passes can ship.

scenes.code:
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: npm test
  deploy:
    needs: test
scenes.say: It's a file in your repo. Push, and the steps run, in order, every time.
That's CI/CD. Small changes, shipped often, checked every time.
